issues.summary: Signin-deleted 'Download your data' links to Export-request (the token page with the chip); the spec says Export-start with the address prefilled.

Precedence is unstated when a new account was already created with the same address during days 30-60. Read literally, Signin-deleted would intercept sign-in to that new account. State that a live account wins.

Export-start's 'no deleted account' error reveals whether an address had an account deleted in the last 30 days. The trade-off is accepted for Signin-deleted but not stated for Export-start, and no rate limit is specified.

crossCutting.summary: (Carried over, not resolved.) §7.2 still overrides the built CSS ('this table wins'), and lines carrying internal QA IDs rose from 81 to 142. §6.2 was excluded this round.

productConfirm: Support-assisted recovery (Q7): the written verification procedure and who may change an email (the main account-takeover risk); how support reaches the person (not the dead mailbox); an expected response time shown on screen C; the same 'Can't get the code?' route at identity sign-in for signed-out people.

Reusable day-30 link: token bound to the address and revoked at day 60; rate limits on Export-start and code sends; the enumeration trade-off on Export-start and Signin-deleted; the open legal check on 60-day retention (Q3).
